settings.heading: Q: "How do I choose the right Huusk knife?"

settings.text:
Start with the tasks you do most often. Chef's knives are versatile for everyday prep, paring knives are designed for smaller detailed work, and specialty knives are shaped for specific cutting tasks. 

Review each product page for its intended use, dimensions, materials, and included items.

settings.heading: Q: "What is included with my knife or knife set?"

settings.text: Each product page lists the exact items included in that product. If a sheath, protective cover, or other accessory is included, it will be stated in the product details. If it is not listed, it is not included.

settings.heading: Q: "Where can I find the knife dimensions and materials?"

settings.text:
Confirmed specifications such as blade length, handle material, blade material, weight, and construction are listed on the relevant product page. Specifications may vary by model, 

so please check the individual listing before ordering.

settings.heading: Q: "Are Huusk knives suitable for everyday home cooking?"

settings.text: Huusk knives are designed for everyday kitchen preparation. Choose the model that matches your preferred tasks and always use the knife on a suitable cutting surface with safe handling practices.

settings.heading: Q: "How should I clean and care for my Huusk knife?"

settings.text:
We recommend hand washing with mild soap, then drying the knife promptly and thoroughly. Do not leave it soaking, and do not place it in the dishwasher. 

Store the knife in a dry, secure place, using the sheath or protective cover when one is included with the product.

settings.heading: Q: "How do I keep the blade performing well?"

settings.text:
Use a suitable cutting board and avoid twisting, prying, or cutting materials the knife was not designed to handle. Regular, appropriate edge maintenance helps preserve cutting performance. 

Follow the care guidance for your specific model.

settings.heading: Q: "What does the lifetime warranty cover?"

settings.text:
Huusk provides a lifetime warranty for damage or issues arising from normal use. The warranty does not cover damage caused by misuse, abuse, accidents, or improper handling. 

For example, using a kitchen knife to chop bones can dull or damage the edge and is considered improper use.

settings.heading: Q: "What should I do if my knife arrives damaged or has a product issue?"

settings.text: Email service@huuskknives.com as soon as possible with your order number and clear photos of the product and packaging. Our team will review the issue and provide the next steps.
We currently ship to addresses within the United States, including contiguous and non-contiguous states, U.S. territories, and the freely associated states.

settings.heading: Q: "How much does shipping cost and how long does delivery take?"

settings.text:
For contiguous U.S. addresses, shipping is $7.99 for orders under $70 and free for orders of $70 or more. Estimated delivery is 3-7 business days after shipment. 

For Alaska, Hawaii, U.S. territories, and freely associated states, shipping is $9.99 under $70 and free at $70 or more, with estimated delivery of 5-14 business days after shipment.

settings.heading: Q: "When will my order be processed?"

settings.text: Orders are typically processed and handed to the carrier within 1-3 business days. Processing may take longer during promotions, major holidays, or temporary restocking periods.

settings.heading: Q: "How can I track my order or report a delivery problem?"

settings.text:
After dispatch, you will receive a shipping confirmation email with tracking details. Allow 24-48 hours for carrier updates to appear. If a package is delayed, stops updating, arrives damaged, 

or is marked delivered but cannot be found, contact service@huuskknives.com. Our shipping warranty covers loss or damage in transit.

settings.heading: Q: "Can I cancel my order after placing it?"

settings.text:
Contact us within 24 hours of placing your order if you need to request a cancellation. Because fulfillment begins quickly, an order that has entered processing or shipping may no longer be cancellable; 

in that case, you can follow the return process after delivery.

settings.heading: Q: "What is Huusk's return and refund policy?"

settings.text:
Our 30-Day Money-Back Guarantee allows you to request a return within 30 days of delivery. Items must be unused, in their original condition, and in the original packaging. 

Final Sale items are not eligible for return or refund. After inspection, refunds are processed within 1 business day to the original payment method; banks may take an additional 3-7 business days.

settings.heading: Q: "How do I start a return or exchange?"

settings.text:
Email service@huuskknives.com with your order number before sending anything back. Do not return the item to the address on the original package; 

our team will provide the authorized return address and instructions. For non-quality-related returns or exchanges, return and replacement shipping costs are the customer's responsibility.

settings.heading: Q: "How quickly will customer support respond?"

settings.text:
Our support team aims to reply in less than 48 hours, including weekends and holidays. For order, delivery, return, or product questions, 

email service@huuskknives.com with your order number and relevant photos or details.
